Test Case Title: Verify a new user can register successfully
Precondition:
User is logged out.
Email address has not been registered before.
Test Steps:
1. Open Automation Exercise.
2. Verify Home page is visible.
3. Click 'Signup / Login'.
4. Verify 'New User Signup!' is visible.
5. Enter valid name and unique email.
6. Click 'Signup'.
7. Verify 'ENTER ACCOUNT INFORMATION' is visible.
8. Fill required account information.
9. Fill required address information.
10. Click 'Create Account'.
11. Verify 'ACCOUNT CREATED!'.
12. Click 'Continue'.
13. Verify 'Logged in as <username>'.
Test Data: Use TD-REGISTER. Use a fresh TD-REGISTER Email (test001/test002/test003...).
Expected Result:
Account is created successfully.
'ACCOUNT CREATED!' is displayed.
After Continue, user is logged in and 'Logged in as <username>' is displayed.
